caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden chest with a dark brown top and sides. The front panel of the chest is divided into three vertical sections, each framed by decorative fluted columns. Each section features a painted arch at the top, beneath which are floral patterns in red, blue, and green tones on a light beige background. The left and right sections each have a large star shape above the floral design, and the numbers "18" and "71" split above the center and right sections, respectively. The middle section features an inscription reading "ANNA MARIA LECHLERIN" above its floral motif, with additional small decorative elements below the flowers. The edges and base of the chest are highlighted with blue-green accents, and the feet are shaped with curved cutouts. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white.
title: Pa. German Chest
